name: aruma-storage-compat-js
description: What the Storage suites of firebase-js-sdk (packages/storage and packages/storage-compat at firebase@13.0.0) need to run from source: the @firebase packages at the versions firebase@13.0.0 ships, and the test tools at the versions its yarn.lock pins, except Playwright, which is the version whose browsers are in .cache/ms-playwright. run.sh installs it with npm ci --ignore-scripts next to the extracted sources.
